WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Framed Wooden Doors and Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.

3. When learning Estimation of Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Estimation of Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Estimation of Materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Estimation of Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Estimation of Materials.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

5. When learning Furniture Making, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Furniture Making.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Furniture Making.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Furniture Making.

6. When learning Entrepreneurship in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.

7. When learning Project Activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Activity.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Activity.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project Activity.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Activity.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

9. When learning Upholstery, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Upholstery.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Upholstery.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Upholstery.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.

10. When learning Emergency Management, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Emergency Management.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emergency Management.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emergency Management.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

12. When learning Occupational Information, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Occupational Information.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Occupational Information.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Occupational Information.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Estimation of Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Occupational Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Emergency Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship in Woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
